# Meetup & Lu.ma Event Finder by City, Group & Calendar

Meetup and Lu.ma host two very different event ecosystems. This actor reads both from one input shape: search by keyword and city, browse a group or calendar, open a specific event URL, or discover what is happening around a city — with pagination, filters, and rich event details.

## What this actor does

- **One actor, two platforms** — set `platform` to `meetup` or `luma` and reuse the same fields
- **Eight intent modes** — keyword search, event lookup, group profile, group/calendar event lists, nearby discovery, trending discovery, and URL auto-routing
- **Full result pages** — Meetup cursor pagination and Lu.ma cursor pagination, not just the first page
- **Useful filters** — dates, event format, radius, minimum attendance, free-only, category, and sort order
- **Rich records** — venue and coordinates, group size, topics, hosts, prices, ticket tiers, and RSVP/guest counts
- **Optional enrichment** — Meetup attendee names/photos and Lu.ma event descriptions/ticket tiers/featured guests, both off by default
- **Monitoring** — `onlyNewSinceLastRun` remembers IDs for the same input and skips them next time
- **Clean data** — empty fields are omitted at every depth; no `null`, `""`, `[]`, or `{}`

No login, cookie, API key, or browser is required.

## Modes

| Mode | Meetup | Lu.ma |
|---|---|---|
| `searchEvents` | Keyword search with location, dates, type, radius, category, attendance | Keyword search, city feed, or category feed |
| `byEvent` | Event URL, `group/eventId` URL, or numeric event ID | Event URL (`lu.ma` or `luma.com`), slug, or `evt-...` ID |
| `byGroup` | Group profile and stats | Calendar/community profile |
| `groupEvents` | Group's upcoming or past events | Calendar's upcoming or past events |
| `byCalendar` | Alias for `groupEvents` | Calendar profile plus its events |
| `discoverNearby` | Recommended events near a location/category | City or nearest featured city feed |
| `discoverTrending` | Recommended events by category/location | Featured city/category feeds |
| `byUrl` | Auto-routes event and group URLs | Auto-routes event and calendar URLs |

## Output per Meetup event

- `id`, `name`, `url` — event identity and link
- `startAt`, `endAt`, `timezone` — scheduling (timezone falls back to the group's timezone)
- `description` — full description from the event payload
- `eventType`, `rsvpState`, `status`, `waitlistMode` — event state
- `imageUrl`, `imageId` — event photo
- `guestCount`, `attendeeCount`, `waitlistCount`, `capacity` — attendance and capacity
- `isFree`, `feeAmount`, `feeCurrency`, `feeAccepts`, `feeRequired` — pricing
- `group`, `groupName`, `groupUrlname`, `groupMemberCount`, `groupCategory` — group summary
- `venueName`, `venueAddress`, `city`, `state`, `country`, `postalCode`, `latitude`, `longitude`, `googleMapsUrl` — venue
- `topics[]` — topic id, name, and urlkey
- `hosts[]` — host name and photo
- `attendees[]` — optional public RSVP names/photos when `includeAttendees` is on (capped at 250)
- `seriesId`, `seriesName` — recurring series, when present
- `recordType`, `platform`, `siteName`, `scrapedAt` — record metadata

## Output per Meetup group

- `id`, `name`, `urlname`, `url`, `timezone`, `description`, `photoUrl`
- `foundedDate`, `city`, `state`, `country`, `latitude`, `longitude`
- `memberCount`, `rating`, `ratingCount`, `isNewGroup`
- `category`, `categoryId`, `categoryUrlkey`, `topics[]`
- `organizer`, `socials` — organizer profile and linked social accounts
- `upcomingEventCount`, `pastEventCount`
- `memberSample[]` — optional public members when `includeMembers` is on

## Output per Lu.ma event

- `id`, `name`, `url`, `slug`, `startAt`, `endAt`, `timezone`
- `description` — full ProseMirror text on detail/enrichment
- `imageUrl`, `eventType`, `locationType`, `waitlistActive`, `hideRsvp`
- `guestCount`, `ticketCount`, `isFree`, `feeAmount`, `maxFeeAmount`, `currency`
- `ticketTiers[]` — tier name, price, currency, type, spots remaining, registration count
- `isSoldOut`, `requireApproval`, `isNearCapacity`, `spotsRemaining`, `registrationAvailability`
- `venues` and `location` fields — `venueName`, `fullAddress`, `venueAddress`, `city`, `state`, `country`, `latitude`, `longitude`
- `hosts[]`, `organizerName`, `featuredGuests[]`
- `calendar`, `calendarName` — calendar identity, socials, website, and location
- `categories[]`, `featuredCity`
- `recordType`, `platform`, `siteName`, `scrapedAt`

## Output per Lu.ma calendar

- `id`, `name`, `slug`, `url`, `description`
- `avatarUrl`, `coverImageUrl`
- `instagram`, `linkedin`, `twitter`, `website`, `socials`
- `timezone`, `city`, `state`, `country`
- `eventCount`, `subscriberCount`, `upcomingEventCount`, `pastEventCount`
- `recordType` (`calendar` or `city`), `platform`, `siteName`, `scrapedAt`

## Output per error record

If a specific URL, slug, or event ID cannot be fetched or parsed, the actor emits an error record rather than silently dropping it:

- `recordType` — `error`
- `platform`, `reason`, `source`, `httpStatus`
- `url`, `slug`, `eventId`, or `groupUrlname` — the identifier that failed
- `scrapedAt`

## Input

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `platform` | select, required | `meetup` | `meetup` or `luma` |
| `mode` | select, required | `searchEvents` | One of the eight modes above |
| `query` | string | – | Keyword; required for Meetup search unless a category is supplied |
| `location` | string | – | City or region used to resolve the search area |
| `lat`, `lng` | number | – | Explicit coordinates; bypasses geocoding |
| `country` | select | – | Optional Meetup country hint |
| `meetupCategory` | select | – | Live Meetup topic category (`all` plus 20 current topics) |
| `lumaCategory` | select | – | Lu.ma category feed (needs a city or coordinates) |
| `eventType` | select | `any` | Meetup: `any`, `physical`, `online`, `hybrid` |
| `sortBy` | select | `relevance` | `relevance`, `dateAsc`, or `dateDesc` |
| `dateFrom`, `dateTo` | string | – | Inclusive date bounds (`YYYY-MM-DD` or ISO date-time) |
| `radiusKm` | integer | – | Meetup search radius, 1–500 km |
| `minAttendees` | integer | – | Minimum RSVPs/guests, 0–100000 |
| `freeOnly` | boolean | `false` | Drop events known to charge |
| `eventPeriod` | select | `upcoming` | `upcoming`, `past`, or `all` for group/calendar modes |
| `urls` | array | `[]` | Meetup or Lu.ma event/group/calendar URLs |
| `slugs` | array | `[]` | Meetup group urlnames or Lu.ma slugs |
| `eventIds` | array | `[]` | Numeric Meetup event IDs (alone or paired with `slugs`) or Lu.ma `evt-...` ids |
| `lumaCity` | select | – | Any of the 87 live Lu.ma featured cities |
| `maxItems` | integer | `50` | Hard cap on records, 1–1000 |
| `includeAttendees` | boolean | `false` | Meetup: add public RSVP names/photos |
| `includeMembers` | boolean | `false` | Meetup groups: add a public member sample |
| `enrichDetails` | boolean | `false` | Lu.ma: fetch detail for descriptions, tiers, featured guests |
| `onlyNewSinceLastRun` | boolean | `false` | Skip IDs already emitted for this exact input |

## Examples

### Search Meetup events in a city

```json
{
  "platform": "meetup",
  "mode": "searchEvents",
  "query": "tech",
  "location": "san francisco",
  "dateFrom": "2026-11-01",
  "eventType": "physical",
  "maxItems": 50
}
```

### Browse a Lu.ma city feed with more than one page

```json
{
  "platform": "luma",
  "mode": "discoverNearby",
  "lumaCity": "sf",
  "maxItems": 100
}
```

### Read a Meetup group's past events

```json
{
  "platform": "meetup",
  "mode": "groupEvents",
  "slugs": ["real-time-analytics-and-ai"],
  "eventPeriod": "past",
  "maxItems": 30
}
```

### Auto-route mixed Meetup and Lu.ma URLs

```json
{
  "platform": "meetup",
  "mode": "byUrl",
  "urls": [
    "https://www.meetup.com/real-time-analytics-and-ai/events/316657797/",
    "https://luma.com/fireworks-8kmc"
  ],
  "includeAttendees": true
}
```

## Use cases

- Build a combined Meetup + Lu.ma event feed for a city or topic
- Track a community group's or calendar's upcoming and past schedule
- Research venues, prices, hosts, and attendance before attending
- Monitor new events for a saved search with `onlyNewSinceLastRun`
- Compare how a topic is represented across both platforms

## FAQ

**Is this affiliated with Meetup or Lu.ma?**
No. This is an independent actor that reads publicly available data from both platforms and is not operated by or affiliated with either.

**Do I need an account, cookie, or API key?**
No. Every supported path works anonymously and cookielessly; nothing is required beyond the input fields.

**Why does a Lu.ma keyword search stop at 50 results?**
Lu.ma's public keyword search is capped at 50 results per query. For more coverage, split the keyword into narrower terms or use a city or category feed, which supports cursor pagination.

**Can I get past events?**
Yes for Meetup groups (`groupEvents` with `eventPeriod: "past"`) and Lu.ma calendars (`byCalendar`, `groupEvents`, or `eventPeriod`). Meetup keyword search and Lu.ma city/category feeds do not expose past events.

**Why are Lu.ma attendee names missing?**
Lu.ma only publishes counts, featured guests, and first-name previews. The full guest list requires a signed-in user with access to the event, so this actor returns counts and featured guests only.

**Are Meetup attendee names public?**
On many events the public RSVP list is visible and can be included with `includeAttendees`. Some organizers hide it; in that case the field is omitted. Attendee data is opt-in and never part of the small default run.

**Why are some prices or venues missing?**
Hosts can hide prices, and some events are online-only or use an obfuscated address. The actor reports only what the platform discloses; it never invents a price or address.

**What happens if a request is blocked?**
The actor retries politely and, only after a real block, makes one automatic proxy retry. There is no proxy field to configure.

**How many records can one run return?**
Up to `maxItems` (maximum 1000). Coverage depends on what the platform publishes for the query, city, group, or calendar.
